explanation: Breadth-first search word transformations, generating every one-character lowercase substitution. Remove discovered dictionary words to mark them visited, and return the first distance reaching the target.
timeComplexity: O(26 N L^2) expected upper-bound time for N visited words of length L, including hashing/copying generated words.
spaceComplexity: O(NL) copied dictionary and queue-string space.
